text: This report provides information regarding the implementation status of publicly reported recommendations made by the Forensic Unit. These recommendations were made in the context of the annual reports on the Fraud and Waste Hotline and investigations. Following up on outstanding recommendations from previous reports is important and ensures that management has taken appropriate action to implement recommendations. From January 1, 2007 to December 31, 2017, a total of 57 recommendations related to City Divisions made by the Forensic Unit were reported publicly. Twenty-nine of them were implemented before 2018.
